verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents a step-by-step walkthrough for setting up SAML-based SSO with custom apps that are not in the pre-integrated catalog, which covers the custom SAML part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows custom OIDC apps or header-based apps. Missing for 10: custom OIDC app configuration, header-based app SSO, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs

citations.quote: প্রি-ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ক্যাটালগে নেই এমন একটি কাস্টম অ্যাপের সাথে SAML-ভিত্তিক SSO সেট আপ করতে এই ধাপগুলি অনুসরণ করুন।
L'authentification unique (SSO) permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter à toutes les applications cloud de leur entreprise à l'aide des identifiants de leur compte Google géré.
